gates.summary: policyengine 6.9.0, policyengine-uk 2.141.6 and policyengine-core 3.33.0 are installed and their requirements hold.
The pinned PyPI wheels match their RECORDs and the installed files (policyengine-uk: 2939 wheel members, 2939 installed files, policyengine-core: 199 wheel members, 199 installed files).
policyengine-core 3.33.0 satisfies policyengine-uk>=3.32.27; certification will record an exact qualified pair, since the publisher's claims do not cover both.
Read the release manifest and 7 artifacts with the configured credential; anonymous access returned HTTP 401.
enhanced_frs_2024_25 is the pinned 128,414,344 bytes with the UK single-year layout.
Supports 2024–2032, covering the required and horizon years.

9 model inputs are newly missing from the data (additional_residential_property_purchased, loss_relief, non_residential_property_purchased, non_residential_property_secured_debt, other_residential_property_secured_debt, pension_annual_allowance_taxable_lump_sum_death_benefits, pension_contributions_via_salary_sacrifice_pre_2015, unused_pension_annual_allowance…)
Contract 2.1.0: every case, property and population check passed (905); 34 pending a methodology call; 120 unsupported by design.

model_only: checks newly warn: inert:war_widows_pension; the model's fiscal partition changed; metrics have no baseline: caseloads.war_widows_pension 2025, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2026, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2027, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2028, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2029, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2030, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2031, spending.war_widows_pension 2025; 153 metric move(s) exceed their review bounds; data_only: 122 metric move(s) exceed their review bounds
All 10 standard reforms ran and moved their targets by at least their minimums in every year from 2025-26 to 2031-32.
